title: Reascend
summary: REASCEND', verb intransitive [re and ascend.] To rise, mount or climb again. REASCEND', verb transitive To mount or ascend again. He mounts aloft and reascends the skies.

inlines.v: REASCEND', verb intransitive [re and ascend.] To rise, mount or climb again. REASCEND', verb transitive To mount or ascend again. He mounts aloft and reascends the skies.
